_meta.method_note: The ~100 most-read Wikimedia pages from each country per day, filtered to *.wikipedia encyclopedia articles (main pages, Special:/search pages and other non-article namespaces removed via curated lists — heuristic, so an occasional non-article title may survive). View counts are Wikimedia's views_ceil, privacy-rounded UP to the next hundred: ceilings, not exact counts. Reading-language mix is the share of those rounded views per Wikipedia edition within the filtered top-100 — an approximation from the top of the distribution; editions represented by a single page are excluded as likely automated-traffic artifacts. Measures Wikipedia readers only, not the general population. Countries Wikimedia withholds (Country and Territory Protection List, or below the volume reporting threshold) carry withheld:true and are never estimated.
